Gastem is a hard rock band from Damascus, Maryland, USA, that was formed in 1985.

Gastem quickly made waves with a high-energy sound that helped define the Mid-Atlantic hard rock scene. Featuring Rob Galpin (vocals/guitar/keys), Craig Stegall (drums), and Mark Emon (RIP) (bass), Mark Schenker (rhythm guitar/bass/keys/Taurus pedals), the band became a staple of the Baltimore - D.C. - Virginia circuit, headlining packed venues and sharing stages with national acts.
